intro.summary: St Hubert is a Catholic bishop remembered for his conversion and later ministry as a shepherd of souls in the Church.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St Hubert Novena below.
blocks.title: Introduction

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. O God, who didst call the blessed Hubert from the vanities of this world to the heights of evangelical perfection, grant, we beseech Thee, that following his example, we may with humble hearts forsake all earthly things and seek only what is eternal. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Litany of St. Hubert Lord, have mercy. Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy. Christ, have mercy. Lord, have mercy. Lord, have mercy. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us. St. Hubert, faithful servant of Christ, pray for us. St. Hubert, who wast turned from sin by a heavenly vision, pray for us. St. Hubert, who didst renounce the pleasures of the world, pray for us. St. Hubert, devoted disciple of St. Lambert, pray for us. St. Hubert, shepherd of the flock of Christ, pray for us. St. Hubert, apostle of the Ardennes, pray for us. St. Hubert, protector of hunters and those who wander in the wilderness, pray for us. St. Hubert, guardian against the snares of the Evil One, pray for us. St. Hubert, model of conversion and perseverance, pray for us. Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, spare us, O Lord. Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, graciously hear us, O Lord. Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, have mercy on us. Glorious St. Hubert, thou who wast once given wholly to worldly pursuits, yet by God’s grace wast turned in an instant toward His love, look upon me in my own need and weakness. Intercede for me before the throne of Almighty God, that I too may hear His voice calling me away from whatever draws me from Him, and that I may respond with the same wholehearted devotion that marked your life from the moment of your conversion. Obtain for me the grace I now seek,

, if it be pleasing to God and for the good of my soul. Patron of the hunt, guard me in the wild places of this world, both those of field and forest, and those of the heart. Let me always recognize God’s hand in His creation, and never pursue earthly things at the cost of my eternal good. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. St Hubert, pray for us! Amen. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, spare us, O Lord. Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, graciously hear us, O Lord. Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, have mercy on us. Glorious St. Hubert, thou who wast once given wholly to worldly pursuits, yet by God’s grace wast turned in an instant toward His love, look upon me in my own need and weakness. Intercede for me before the throne of Almighty God, that I too may hear His voice calling me away from whatever draws me from Him, and that I may respond with the same wholehearted devotion that marked your life from the moment of your conversion. Obtain for me the grace I now seek, , if it be pleasing to God and for the good of my soul. Patron of the hunt, guard me in the wild places of this world, both those of field and forest, and those of the heart. Let me always recognize God’s hand in His creation, and never pursue earthly things at the cost of my eternal good. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. St Hubert, pray for us! Amen. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
